openArticles: nine previously registered M3x8 adapter/housing screws and the full-length cartridge stack fasteners
6655K17 opposed thrust bearings, both sets of races, balls and cages
machined thrust diaphragm, axial shim, end cap, cartridge screws and shaft retention
new two-sill upper supports and their fasteners, replacing the independent tower feet and knees
sensor, limits, fixture attachments and dressed motor cable; the ninth SPARK MAX is separately budgeted to electronics
mouth/guide wear surfaces, article containment and any production adjustment required by the registered 30 A duty
scope: Shared robot mass planning uses only a single 8.2 kg upper. This comparison includes 68 historical physical stock weights and six independent declared purchased-article catalog masses. It does not import the retired tower geometry or imply a fully mated 002 pan. The documented gearbox output is one assembly split into two bodies in CAD and counted once by procurement.
